## Current Projects

- *Causal Discovery.* How do we learn a causal model?
  [Refs:](#){.refs} [Biometrics (2024)](https://academic.oup.com/biometrics/article/80/3/ujae067/7723282) • [Biometrics (2021)](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/epdf/10.1111/biom.13281)

- *Causal Artificial Intelligence.* Causal reasoning is key to enhance general AI; DAGs provide a practical framework.
  [Tutorial (PDF)](docs/2025-09-SISBAYES2025.pdf){.refs}

- *Replication Studies.* Was a treatment effect truly reproduced in follow-up studies?
  [Refs:](#){.refs} [TEST (2025)](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11749-025-00985-7) • [Psychological Methods (2024)](https://psycnet.apa.org/fulltext/2023-97877-001.html)

- *Bayesian Experimental Design.* Using priors/Bayes factors to plan studies for causal discovery and model discrimination.
  [Refs:](#){.refs} [Statistical Science (2024)](https://projecteuclid.org/journals/statistical-science/volume-39/issue-2/Bayesian-Sample-Size-Determination-for-Causal-Discovery/10.1214/23-STS905.short) • [TEST (2023)](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11749-023-00916-4)

- *Bayesian Mendelian Randomization under Heterogeneity.* Cluster heterogeneous causal effects and handle pleiotropy with robust priors. (Sorry no paper, yet)
